task: Harvey Track C follow-up: physical-background tail statistics, MC scaling, and practical next-step recommendation

verified_relationships: u>3.5 and score>=0.9997 are DIFFERENT populations (110 vs 100 all-background raw events)
u>4.5 and score>=0.99997 are IDENTICAL populations (15 all-background raw events each, verified by direct per-event re-thresholding, zero events in the intervening sliver)

primary_data_sources: /uscms_data/d3/iturkmen/hh4b_delphes/paper_exports/track_b_harvey_score_tail_diagnostics_20260829_v3/HARVEY_LIKELIHOOD_BIN_TABLE.md and ERRATA.md (corrected 9-bin decomposition, v1 bug NOT reused)

methodology.tail_counts: Direct re-thresholding of already-frozen per-event scores: FULL_QCD_SURVIVOR_SIDECAR.h5's score_spanet_10m column for QCD; job_summary_*.json's per-event 'survivors' [file_idx, entry_idx, score, flag] lists for ttbar and the 14 minor backgrounds. No event was rescored.
methodology.weighted_yield_Neff: Flat per-process weight_450fb convention, B=sum(n_k*w_k), sum_w2=sum(n_k*w_k^2), N_eff=B^2/sum_w2, reused unchanged from track_b_harvey_score_tail_diagnostics_20260829_v5_background_stats_audit.
methodology.qcd_scaling: Physical yield B held fixed; QCD's own sum_w2 divided by the multiplier K (weight ~ 1/N_generated, count ~ N_generated); minor-background sum_w2 held fixed (not regenerated). Superseded v4 model (which incorrectly let B grow with raw count) is NOT used.
methodology.resource_estimate: Rate = 1.3517 CPU-slot-hr / 50,000 events (allocated-wall) and 1.2461 (CPU-busy), from the only real measured Pythia8+Delphes QCD generation receipt in this project. Explicitly labeled CPU-slot-hours, never called wall time; wall time given only as illustrative hours-divided-by-slots.
methodology.stability_bin_decomposition: Uses the v3-corrected 9-bin score-space likelihood table (terminal cumulative bin properly included, n=12, 77.10% of total Z_A^2), NOT the v1 bug that folded the terminal population into a mislabeled 15-event display bin.

independent_cross_checks.result: ALL CROSS-CHECKS PASSED -- every recomputed value matches the values used in HARVEY_PHYSICAL_TAIL_STATS_FINAL.md and the independently-published source packages to the digit or floating-point precision. One drafting error was caught and corrected (eps_S=4.0% WP support-tier label, EXTREMELY_LIMITED -> LIMITED, matching the frozen support_tier_overall field).
